exact_completeness_proof: The fixed cross minor is nonzero after good reduction, giving 361 independent characteristic-zero vectors in K1. The fixed full Reynolds restriction has rank 276 after good reduction, so characteristic-zero nullity is at most 637-276=361.
exact_vanishing_proof: For x fixed by an involution t, every dual covariant q satisfies q(x)=t^(-T)q(x), so four q-values lie in the 3-dimensional dual plus-space. Their generalized cross is zero. Equivariance gives all 55 planes.
